name: firstmate-context-handoff
description: Firstmate context handoff for Claude Code, main-window part: once a session has used 250k tokens of context and the per-home config/context-handoff switch is on, the captain's main window offers /stow and then a clear that carries the stow receipt into the fresh session, and a secondmate runs /stow itself. Ship and scout workers are served by firstmate-context-handoff-worker instead.
